intro: A persistent, curriculum-linked learning home: each student has personal topics, progress and next steps across subjects. Compare LearnAI's implemented engine separately from its full intended platform.
caution: Snapshot: 1 November 2026. First-party documentation review, not hands-on benchmarking. Not verified means unknown, not absent. Subject breadth is not the same as validated teaching or assessment. No weighted scores or winner ranking. Competitors will also evolve.

D: Public first-party documentation describes the capability; not independently tested.
S: Related capability exists, but with the limitation described in the cell.
N: Not established in the reviewed sources. This does not mean absent.
F: LearnAI engine/code exists, with no complete student product for this capability.
P: LearnAI roadmap or stated product intent; not a shipped capability.
B: Known implementation gap in the current LearnAI workspace.
O: Possible extension or integration whose scope is not committed.

features.label: Subject coverage
features.definition: Distinguish curated subject content, uploaded material, and an LMS hosting arbitrary courses.

features.label: School / university curriculum
features.definition: Actual syllabus/course alignment, not merely asking a chatbot about a topic.

features.label: Persistent student workspace
features.definition: Saved personal courses, topics and progress across visits; session memory alone is narrower.

features.label: What to study next
features.definition: Recommendations or automatic sequencing without needing a fresh prompt each session.

features.label: Placement / knowledge gaps
features.definition: Assessment of starting knowledge and readiness; recommendation logic need not be a prerequisite graph.

features.label: Contextual tutoring
features.definition: Interactive or instructional support, with the actual scope described.

features.label: Learn / practise / review / test
features.definition: Functional coverage, not matching product feature names or equal mode permissions.

features.label: Spaced / delayed review
features.definition: Distinguish memory-based scheduling from periodic reassessment or a flashcard button.

features.label: Assistance vs independence
features.definition: Evidence of unaided competence, separately from success while receiving tutoring.

features.label: Subject-appropriate assessment
features.definition: Supported grading/checks/rubrics; not a guarantee of correctness across every discipline.

features.label: Course materials / rich content
features.definition: Files, images, other inputs and subject/topic-specific presentation.

features.label: School / university workflows
features.definition: Assignments, reporting and integrations; not all products are full LMS alternatives.

roadmap: Quadratics, supported verification, tutor context, evidence and evaluation. No persistent student UI.
Quality/content presentation, authentication, storage, student workspace and resumable learning.
Scheduled retrieval; knowledge-frontier placement and teaching with fading support.
Course overlays, syllabus topics, school/uni progression, exams and ongoing next-step planning. Mapping/import workflow still needs design.
Maths, chemistry, history, English and other disciplines. Original sequence proposes physics as the first second-subject test; each needs content and suitable assessment.
Bring-your-own problems with follow-up practice; subject-specific blocks. Photo input, interactive elements and exact timing remain open.
Decide LMS complement versus replacement, integrations, teacher/parent views and administration. Student curriculum alignment does not settle these.
